title: Cloud 10.7 AWS Israel is missing from the environment filter
problem: The Cloud 10.7 Victoria new-stack table lists Israel, but the reviewed VersionCompass environment catalog cannot select that location. The proposed catalog change is held after it triggered the existing Advisor region dependency gate.

exclusions: Existing-stack migration, feature availability, premium pairing, historical rollout and regulated authorization remain separate.

scopeComparison: The official service documentation covers new Victoria stacks. The gap is in the VersionCompass selector and does not question Splunk service availability.

impact.customerScenario: A reader is evaluating the documented Israel location for a new AWS Victoria stack.
impact.consequence: The shared environment filter cannot represent the exact location, so the reader may miss the hosting evidence.

confidence.rationale: The two exact public Splunk sections agree on the location and version line, and the pinned reviewed dataset lacks an Israel region entry.

lifecycle.reason: Candidate held after testing exposed a shared Advisor dependency. CSP FedRAMP Watch and Guidance Audit review the exact dependency and affected exports by November 10, 2026.

evidence.section: Available regions and region differences > Victoria Experience > AWS
evidence.statement: Israel appears in the AWS Victoria new-stack column.
